protocol.training: Same initial random vector and mutation draws; 32 greedy bounded uniform mutations per initializer. Every candidate evaluated through three self-generated descendants on fixed training-support/query populations. task_only minimizes parent query loss averaged across three query sets; self_target minimizes mean descendant query loss. Both pay full identical compute; chosen initial artifact is candidate parent.
protocol.budget: 33 candidates per initializer, each charged three full self-target proposal/evaluation unrolls plus parent query evaluation. Fresh evaluation arms each receive eight scalar meta-objective probes per generation, unconditional child adoption.
protocol.evaluation: Clean-process proposals and scoring; no holdout score affects training or descendants; fixed external scalar oracle and interpreter.
protocol.limits: An external evolutionary search trains initial parameters. The experiment tests useful heredity, not independence from external optimization or AGI. No retuning or stopping based on results.
protocol.mechanism: Replace unconstrained tanh displacement with positive learned rate in [0,0.25], multiplied by internal scalar-probe gradient estimate. Zero gradient gives zero update. Probe geometry unchanged; no guaranteed true-gradient descent under noisy directions.
protocol.rateTraining: After each learned initializer, calibrate one fixed conventional meta-step rate by33 candidates and3 update generations on independent training-support/query tasks. Charge complete calibration cost equally to all evaluation arms; no holdout-dependent selection.

primaryEndpoint.contrast: (fixed learned proposer loss - hereditary loss) / fixed learned proposer loss
primaryEndpoint.rule: Both practical median and directional sign test must pass. No seed selection, early stopping, architecture changes or tuning.

protocol.reproductionAudit: Every clean-process proposal and score is repeated directly with same artifact/input; exact equality required. Audit operations charged separately, not evidence of independent replication or improvement.
